questions.question: 4 times the present age of P exceeds the present age of Q by 19 years. After 5 years, 3 times the age of Q will be 27 years less than 9 the age of P. The present age of Q is (in years):
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the present ages of P and Q be P and Q respectively. Given: 4P − Q = 19 ... (i)

After 5 years, the condition is: 9(P + 5) − 3(Q + 5) = 27

Dividing by 3 gives: 3(P + 5) − (Q + 5) = 9 ⇒ 3P − Q = −1 ... (ii)

Subtracting (ii) from (i): (4P − Q) − (3P − Q) = 19 − (−1) ⇒ P = 20.

Substituting P = 20 in (i): 4 × 20 − Q = 19 ⇒ 80 − 19 = Q ⇒ Q = 61.

**∴ The correct answer is 61 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

1) 4 times the present age of P exceeds Q by 19 years.

2) After 5 years, 3 times the age of Q will be 27 less than 9 times the age of P.

 
 Present Age
 Age of P = P
 Age of Q = Q
 4P − Q = 19

 
 After 5 Years
 Age of P = P + 5
 Age of Q = Q + 5
 9(P+5) − 3(Q+5) = 27

 
• 
 

 + 5 yrs

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the present ages of P and Q be P and Q respectively.

⇒ According to the first condition:

⇒ 4P − Q = 19

⇒ Q = 4P − 19 ---- (Equation 1)

⇒ According to the second condition (after 5 years):

⇒ 3(Q + 5) = 9(P + 5) − 27

⇒ 3Q + 15 = 9P + 45 − 27

⇒ 3Q + 15 = 9P + 18

⇒ 3Q − 9P = 3

⇒ Dividing the entire equation by 3:

⇒ Q − 3P = 1 ---- (Equation 2)

⇒ Substitute the value of Q from Equation 1 into Equation 2:

⇒ (4P − 19) − 3P = 1

⇒ P − 19 = 1

⇒ P = 20

⇒ Substitute the value of P in Equation 1 to find Q:

⇒ Q = 4(20) − 19

⇒ Q = 80 − 19

⇒ Q = 61

**∴ The correct answer is 61 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Problems on Ages

If the current age of a person is x, then their age n years ago was (x − n) and their age after n years will be (x + n).

Ratio of Ages

If the ratio of the present ages of A and B is a : b, their ages can be assumed as ax and bx. After n years, their new ages will be (ax + n) and (bx + n).

Linear Equations in Two Variables

Age calculation problems often involve creating a system of linear equations from the given conditions and solving them systematically using substitution or elimination methods to find the unknown variables.

questions.question: Simplify: (1 + cot² A) + (1 + (1)/(cot² A))
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Put A = 45° in the given expression.

⇒ (1 + cot²45°) + (1 + 1/cot²45°)

⇒ (1 + 1) + (1 + 1) = 4

Now check the given options for A = 45°:

Option 3 ⇒ cosec²45° × sec²45° = (√2)² × (√2)² = 2 × 2 = 4

**∴ The correct answer is cosec²A sec²A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(1 + cot²A) + (1 + 1/cot²A)

**Formula Used:**

1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ

1 + tan²θ = sec²θ

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

**Calculations:**

⇒ We know that 1 / cot²A = tan²A

⇒ The expression becomes: (1 + cot²A) + (1 + tan²A)

⇒ Using identities: cosec²A + sec²A

⇒ Converting into sine and cosine: (1 / sin²A) + (1 / cos²A)

⇒ Taking LCM: (cos²A + sin²A) / (sin²A × cos²A)

⇒ Applying sin²A + cos²A = 1: 1 / (sin²A × cos²A)

⇒ Separating the terms: (1 / sin²A) × (1 / cos²A)

⇒ Converting back: cosec²A × sec²A

**∴ The correct answer is cosec²A sec²A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Trigonometric Identities

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 | 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ | 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ

Reciprocal Identities

sinθ = 1 / cosecθ | cosθ = 1 / secθ | tanθ = 1 / cotθ

Special Trigonometric Relation

sec²θ + cosec²θ = sec²θ × cosec²θ. The sum of these two specific squares is identically equal to their product.
</p

questions.question: P, Q and R invest a sum in the ratio of 59 : 14 : 72, respectively. If they earned a total profit of ₹4,790 at the end of the year, what is the difference between the shares of Q and R?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the time period is the same, the profit ratio is equal to the investment ratio.

Total ratio parts = 59 + 14 + 72 = 145 parts.

Difference in ratio parts of Q and R = 72 − 14 = 58 parts.

Difference amount = (58 ÷ 145) × 4790

⇒ (2 ÷ 5) × 4790 = 2 × 958 = 1916

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,916.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Investment ratio of P, Q, and R = 59 : 14 : 72

Total profit earned at the end of the year = ₹4,790

**Formula Used:**

Profit Share = (Individual Ratio Part ÷ Total Ratio Parts) × Total Profit

 Profit Distribution Ratio
 
 
 
 
 
 P: 59 parts
 Q: 14
 R: 72 parts
 
 

 Difference (R − Q) = 58 parts

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total sum of ratios = 59 + 14 + 72 = 145 parts

⇒ The total profit corresponds to 145 parts = ₹4,790

⇒ Value of 1 part = 4790 ÷ 145

⇒ Difference in parts of Q and R = 72 − 14 = 58 parts

⇒ Difference in amount = 58 × (4790 ÷ 145)

⇒ We can simplify the fraction (58 ÷ 145) by dividing the numerator and denominator by their common factor 29.

⇒ (29 × 2 = 58) and (29 × 5 = 145)

⇒ Simplified multiplier = 2 ÷ 5

⇒ Difference in amount = (2 ÷ 5) × 4790

⇒ Difference in amount = 2 × 958 = ₹1,916

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,916.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Partnership Profit Ratio

When the time period of investment is the same for all partners, the profit is distributed in the exact ratio of their capital investments. Profit Ratio = C₁ : C₂ : C₃.

Different Time Periods

When time periods vary, the profit is distributed in the ratio of the product of capital and time. Profit Ratio = (C₁ × T₁) : (C₂ × T₂).

Active and Sleeping Partners

An active partner may receive an additional fixed salary or percentage of total profit for managing the business. The remaining profit is then distributed among all partners based on their investment ratio.

questions.question: The value of sqrt{121}+sqrt{0.0196}-sqrt{8.41}
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

√121 = 11

√0.0196 = 0.14 (Since 14² = 196 and root of 4 decimal places gives 2 decimal places)

√8.41 = 2.9 (Since 29² = 841 and root of 2 decimal places gives 1 decimal place)

⇒ 11 + 0.14 − 2.9 = 8.24

**∴ The correct answer is 8.24.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: √121 + √0.0196 − √8.41

**Calculation:**

⇒ √121 = 11

⇒ √0.0196 = √(196 ÷ 10000)

⇒ √(196 ÷ 10000) = 14 ÷ 100 = 0.14

⇒ √8.41 = √(841 ÷ 100)

⇒ √(841 ÷ 100) = 29 ÷ 10 = 2.9

Substitute these values into the given expression:

⇒ 11 + 0.14 − 2.9

⇒ 11.14 − 2.90

⇒ 8.24

**∴ The correct answer is 8.24.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square Roots of Decimals

When taking the square root of a decimal number, the perfect square must have an even number of decimal places. The resulting square root will have exactly half as many decimal places.

BODMAS Rule

This rule dictates the exact order of mathematical operations: Brackets, Orders (including square roots and exponents), Division × Multiplication, and Addition − Subtraction.

Common Perfect Squares

Memorizing perfect squares such as 14² = 196 and 29² = 841 helps in solving root-based simplification questions accurately and rapidly without manual division.
</p

questions.question: Find the perimeter of a semicircle with a radius of 7 cm. (Use pi = 22/7 )
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct formula for the perimeter of a semicircle: P = r × (π + 2)

Using π = 22/7, the multiplying factor (π + 2) always becomes 36/7.

P = 7 × (36/7)

P = 36 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 36 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the semicircle (r) = 7 cm

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter of a semicircle = Arc Length + Diameter

Perimeter = πr + 2r

 

 
 
• 
 r = 7 cm
 Diameter = 2r = 14 cm
 Arc Length = πr

**Calculations:**

⇒ Arc length = 22/7 × 7

⇒ Arc length = 22 cm

⇒ Diameter = 2 × 7

⇒ Diameter = 14 cm

⇒ Total Perimeter = Arc length + Diameter

⇒ Total Perimeter = 22 + 14 = 36 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 36 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Semicircle

The area of a semicircle is exactly half of the area of a full circle. Formula: Area = 1/2 × πr²

Perimeter of a Quarter Circle

A quarter circle's perimeter is made up of a curved arc and two separate radii enclosing it. Formula: Perimeter = πr/2 + 2r

Area of a Quarter Circle

The area is exactly one-fourth of the area of a full circle. Formula: Area = 1/4 × πr²

questions.question: Anjani can do a certain piece of work in 30 days. Anjani and Khushbu can together do the same work in 10 days, and Anjani, Khushbu and Sushmita can do the same work together in 9 days. In how many days can Anjani and Sushmita do the same work together?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM(30, 10, 9) = 90 units.

Efficiency of Anjani = 90 ÷ 30 = 3 units/day.

Efficiency of (Anjani + Khushbu + Sushmita) = 90 ÷ 9 = 10 units/day.

Efficiency of (Anjani + Khushbu) = 90 ÷ 10 = 9 units/day.

Efficiency of Sushmita = 10 − 9 = 1 unit/day.

Time for Anjani + Sushmita = 90 ÷ (3 + 1) = 90 ÷ 4 = 45/2 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 45/2 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by Anjani (A) = 30 days

Time taken by Anjani and Khushbu (A + K) = 10 days

Time taken by Anjani, Khushbu and Sushmita (A + K + S) = 9 days

Total Work is taken as the LCM of all given days: LCM(30, 10, 9) = 90 units.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Efficiency of S = Efficiency of (A + K + S) − Efficiency of (A + K)

⇒ Efficiency of S = 10 − 9 = 1 unit/day

⇒ Combined efficiency of A and S = Efficiency of A + Efficiency of S

⇒ Combined efficiency of A and S = 3 + 1 = 4 units/day

**∴ The correct answer is 45/2 days.**

Pipes & Cisterns

Works on the same logic as Time & Work. Inlet pipes have positive efficiency, and outlet (emptying) pipes have negative efficiency.

Work and Wages

Wages are distributed in direct proportion to the actual amount of work done. If people work for the same number of days, wages are proportional to their efficiencies.

Alternate Day Work

MDH Formula

questions.question: The number of prime numbers lying between 488 and 494, both included, is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In the range 488 to 494, we can immediately ignore all even numbers.

We only need to check the odd numbers: 489, 491, and 493.

489 is divisible by 3 (sum of digits is 21) and 493 is divisible by 17 (17 × 29 = 493).

491 is not divisible by any prime number up to √491 ≈ 22, hence it is a prime number.

Thus, there is only 1 prime number in the given range.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Range of numbers: 488 to 494 (both included).

**Concept Used:**

A prime number has only two distinct factors: 1 and itself.

To check if a number N is prime, we divide it by all prime numbers less than or equal to √N.

**Calculations:**

⇒ The given numbers are 488, 489, 490, 491, 492, 493, 494.

⇒ Even numbers (488, 490, 492, 494) are divisible by 2, so they are not prime.

⇒ Now, check the remaining odd numbers: 489, 491, 493.

⇒ 489: Sum of digits = 4 + 8 + 9 = 21. Since 21 is divisible by 3, 489 is not prime.

⇒ 493: We check prime factors up to √493 ≈ 22 (Primes: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19).

⇒ 493 ÷ 17 = 29. Since it is perfectly divisible by 17, 493 is not prime.

⇒ 491: We check prime factors up to √491 ≈ 22.

⇒ 491 is not divisible by 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, or 19.

⇒ Thus, 491 is a prime number.

⇒ There is exactly 1 prime number lying between 488 and 494.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Prime Numbers

A natural number greater than 1 that has exactly two distinct positive divisors: 1 and itself (e.g., 2, 3, 5, 7, 11).

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are co-prime (or mutually prime) if their highest common factor (HCF) is exactly 1. They do not need to be prime numbers themselves.

Primality Test

To systematically check if a number N is prime, find the largest integer less than or equal to √N and check for divisibility by all prime numbers up to that integer.
</p

questions.question: The income of Raman is ₹86,400. He saves 22.5% of his income. If his income increases by 22% and expenditure increases by 25%, then his savings will:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since Income = Expenditure + Savings, the overall increase in Income must equal the sum of increases in Expenditure and Savings.

Total increase in Income = 22% of ₹86,400 = ₹19,008.

Original Expenditure = (100% − 22.5%) = 77.5% of ₹86,400 = (31 ÷ 40) × 86400 = ₹66,960.

Total increase in Expenditure = 25% of ₹66,960 = (1 ÷ 4) × 66960 = ₹16,740.

Increase in Savings = ₹19,008 − ₹16,740 = ₹2,268.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,268.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial Income = ₹86,400

Savings percentage = 22.5%

Increase in Income = 22%

Increase in Expenditure = 25%

 Sav = 22.5%
 Original Income (100%) = ₹86,400

 
 
 
 New Exp = 96.875%
 Sav = 25.125%
 New Income (122%)

 
 
• 
 
• 

 
 Net change in Savings = 25.125% − 22.5% = + 2.625%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the original income be 100%.

⇒ Original Savings = 22.5%

⇒ Original Expenditure = 100% − 22.5% = 77.5%

⇒ New Income = 100% + 22% = 122%

⇒ New Expenditure = 77.5% + (25% of 77.5%) = 77.5% × 1.25 = 96.875%

⇒ New Savings = New Income − New Expenditure

⇒ New Savings = 122% − 96.875% = 25.125%

⇒ Net change in Savings = 25.125% − 22.5% = 2.625% (Increase)

⇒ Actual increase in Savings = 2.625% of ₹86,400

⇒ Actual increase = (2.625 ÷ 100) × 86400 = 2.625 × 864 = ₹2,268

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,268.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income-Expenditure Equation

Income always equals the sum of Expenditure and Savings. Any percentage change in income is distributed among expenditure and savings based on their weighted initial values.

Alligation in Income-Expenditure

Successive Percentage Change

When a base value undergoes multiple changes independently, tracking changes on a constant base of 100% makes fraction simplification and final difference calculations much faster.

questions.question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹4,000 at 7.5% per annum rate of interest deposited on 5 February 2024 and withdrawn on 6 April 2024.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total days = 24 (Feb) + 31 (Mar) + 6 (Apr) = 61 days.

Since 2024 is a leap year (366 days), time in years = 61 ÷ 366 = 1/6 year.

Simple Interest = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

questions.question: The product of two consecutive positive natural numbers is 930. The greater of the two numbers is:

The product of two consecutive positive natural numbers is slightly greater than the square of the smaller number.

We know that 30² = 900, so the smaller number should be close to 30.

Let's check the product of 30 and the next natural number: 30 × 31 = 930.

The numbers are 30 and 31, and the greater number among them is 31.

**∴ The correct answer is 31.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Quadratic equation formulation: x(x + 1) = Product

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the smaller positive natural number be x.

⇒ The next consecutive positive natural number is (x + 1).

⇒ Product of the numbers = x × (x + 1) = 930

⇒ x² + x − 930 = 0

⇒ To solve this quadratic equation, we split the middle term.

⇒ x² + 31x − 30x − 930 = 0

⇒ x(x + 31) − 30(x + 31) = 0

⇒ (x − 30)(x + 31) = 0

⇒ Since x must be a positive natural number, x = 30.

⇒ The smaller number is 30.

⇒ The greater number is x + 1 = 30 + 1 = 31.

**∴ The correct answer is 31.**

questions.question: Which of the following numbers divides 934725?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To check divisibility by 3, simply calculate the sum of all digits in the number.

Sum of digits of 934725 = 9 + 3 + 4 + 7 + 2 + 5 = 30.

Since 30 is completely divisible by 3, the entire number 934725 is also divisible by 3.

Since the last digit is 5 (an odd number), it cannot be divided by 2, 6, or 10.

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number = 934725

**Method Used:**

Apply the standard divisibility rules for each given option.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Divisibility by 2: The last digit must be an even number (0, 2, 4, 6, 8).

⇒ The last digit of 934725 is 5 (odd), so it is not divisible by 2.

⇒ Divisibility by 6: The number must be divisible by both 2 and 3.

⇒ Since it is not divisible by 2, it is not divisible by 6.

⇒ Divisibility by 10: The last digit must be 0.

⇒ The last digit is 5, so it is not divisible by 10.

⇒ Divisibility by 3: The sum of the digits must be a multiple of 3.

⇒ Sum of digits = 9 + 3 + 4 + 7 + 2 + 5 = 30

⇒ 30 ÷ 3 = 10 (perfectly divisible)

⇒ Hence, the number 934725 is divisible by 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility by 4

A number is divisible by 4 if the number formed by its last two digits is perfectly divisible by 4.

Divisibility by 5

A number is completely divisible by 5 if its last digit is either 0 or 5.

Divisibility by 9

A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of all its individual digits is a multiple of 9.

Divisibility by 11

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of digits at odd places and the sum of digits at even places is 0 or a multiple of 11.

questions.question: The H.C.F. and the L.C.M. of two numbers are 11 and 495, respectively. If one of the numbers is 55, find the other one.
